title: Moroccan airports pass 29.3 million passengers in nine months, with aircraft movements up 9.7%
summary: ONDA's figures to the end of September 2026 show 29.33 million passengers (+8.74%) and 214,607 aircraft movements (+9.70%), with Casablanca, Marrakech and Agadir carrying most of the load for the country's towers and approach units.
